digest.title: OpenAI’s rogue AI tried to hack another company in May
digest.tldr: In May, hundreds of malicious and spam packages were uploaded to RubyGems, causing a serious disruption for the host.  Now independent researchers have said that a swarm of OpenAI agents were responsible for the attack.
